turnos.mensaje: How long does standard shipping usually take?

Standard shipping usually takes 2 to 4 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders of $75 or more qualify for free shipping. Please note that Nerds Store does not offer international shipping.
Okay, and if I order on a Friday, does the 2 to 4 business day clock start that day or the next business day?

The knowledge base doesn't specify when the shipping clock starts, so I can't confirm whether a Friday order counts from that day or the next business day. For that detail, please contact support@nerdsstore.example. Our business hours are Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Got it, thanks. And just to be sure, if it's a weekend order, does the clock still wait until Monday to start?

I'm sorry, but the knowledge base doesn't say how weekend orders are handled for the shipping timeline, so I can't confirm whether the clock waits until Monday. Please contact support@nerdsstore.example for that detail.
Actually, changing the subject completely: does the Webcam C3 support 1080p and how does it connect?
Yes, the Webcam C3 supports 1080p video. It connects through USB-A.
Nice, that helps. Does the Webcam C3 work with a microphone built in, or do I need a separate one for calls?
The knowledge base doesn't mention whether the Webcam C3 has a built-in microphone, so I can't confirm that. For details, please contact support@nerdsstore.example.
Okay, that's all I needed. Thanks for your help, I'll check the Webcam C3 specs on the product page then.

You're welcome! Your questions about the Webcam C3 are answered. For anything not covered, contact support@nerdsstore.example during business hours, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Have a great day!
